issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders has a type mismatch between the problem specification and the reference solution. The UML in the problem statement declares totalOrders as int (problem_statement.md line 28), while the solution implementation declares it as long (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 6). This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected type for the totalOrders field and the getter signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution's declaration to 'private int totalOrders' (and update its getter return type) to match the UML/spec, or update the problem statement/UML to specify 'long' if larger counts are intended. Ensure the chosen type is used consistently in the specification, template (when added), and solution so students know the exact expected type.
